content.title: View the current subscription plan on the dashboard
content.description: An account holder opens or reloads the dashboard and sees the true, persisted subscription plan fetched from the server—`Free` or `Pro` as currently stored—rather than a hardcoded or stale default, and after an upgrade the indicator must show `Pro` instead of continuing to display `Free`.
content.summary: See the persisted plan on the dashboard.
content.value: Gives users an accurate, current view of their subscription state so the dashboard reflects real account status before and after changes.
criteria: on page load, the dashboard shows the server-persisted plan value, and the supported displayed states are "Free" or "Pro" rather than a hardcoded or stale default
after an upgrade and return or reload, the plan indicator shows "Pro" and must not continue showing "Free"
